title: Bell violation follows locally by violating Statistical Independence

statements.text: For large enough $p$, the discretized Hilbert space describes quantum ensembles in a framework where the Statistical Independence assumption of Bell's theorem is formally violated. Bell inequalities are then violated without nonlocality or indefinite reality, so the theory is superdeterministic in that formal sense and locally causal.

sources.quote: the discretised model can explain the violation of Bell inequalities without appealing to nonlocality or indefinite reality
We continue to insist that IST provides a plausible deterministic locally causal interpretation of the violation of Bell’s inequality
